title: 295 Linwood Field Plan

missions.name: Drone photos
missions.note: One waypoint mission, morning. Lot lines go on in post. Keep Main St behind the camera.

missions.name: Mission A · Half-orbit
missions.note: Own mission, POI on the lot center. East side only, NE to SE, so the commercial on Main St never enters the frame.

missions.name: Mission B · Video
missions.note: Street views RJ asked for: the rise to the skyline, then north up Linwood, then south toward the Medical Campus and downtown.

missions.name: Ground set
missions.note: Afternoon, sun behind you. Flag the corner pins if Joe has a survey; otherwise lines go on in post.

missions.name: Mapping
missions.note: Grid mission for the ortho and model, midday when shadows are short. Nadir P3 flies right after.

P1.why: Lead listing image. Looks west over the lot to Linwood; Main St is behind the camera.

P2.why: The street view north: the lot in front, the historic block toward W Utica.

P3.why: For the lot-line graphic. 200 ft to fit the full depth; crop tight to the lot.

P4.t: South to Med Campus and downtown
P4.why: High frame down Linwood to the Medical Campus and skyline. Label both in post.

V2.why: Half lap on the east side, camera locked on the lot, Linwood behind it.

V3.why: Straight down on the lot, climb, tilt up to face the skyline to the south.

V4.why: Fly north along the east sidewalk, climbing, toward W Utica.

V1.why: Fly south along Linwood, climbing, so the Medical Campus and downtown rise into frame.

P5.why: Frontage from both sidewalks and up and down the street, corners flagged or lines in post.

V5.why: Rise from the west sidewalk facing south down Linwood, the lot passing below.

D1.why: Ortho of the lot and neighbors with parcel lines, model of the adjoining houses.

light_note: Drone in the morning (8 to 10): cameras look west over the lot with the sun behind them and Main St behind the camera. Map at 11:30. Ground photos in the afternoon (2:30 to 4), looking east from the Linwood sidewalks with the sun behind you.
checklist: Airspace checked on B4UFLY or Aloft
Hunt OK to take off from the lot, in writing
Neighbors told (houses close both sides, pool to the south)
Corner pins: flagged if found, otherwise lines in post
Main St behind every camera; no full orbit
Linwood moves over the sidewalk, in traffic gaps
Camera settings locked: white balance, shutter, ISO
Batteries warm, hover 30 s before climbing
footnote: Altitudes are AGL from takeoff on the lot. Lot lines are approximate, traced from imagery; pull the Erie County parcel before marking photos. TBD heights are still being set. Imagery ©2026 Google, Airbus, Maxar Technologies.
